name: webquokka
description: WebQuokka monorepo — the public website and the staff CRM / client portal.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:management
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/web && npm install --prefix apps/management
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/web && npm run lint --prefix apps/management
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec --prefix apps/management -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: npm exec --prefix apps/management -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: npm exec --prefix apps/management -- prisma db seed
